# Velaire Heating & Air

> Velaire is a fictional, WebMCP-native Chicago HVAC service demonstration. Agents can check fit, inspect evidence, open and follow service cases, negotiate, prepare bookings, and compare changed work. Only visible human controls can send or approve commitments.

## Primary routes

- [HVAC service website](https://promisediff-webmcp.vercel.app/): Registers 10 customer WebMCP tools and presents services, price bands, service area, evidence, and the human-approval policy.
- [Customer AI service desk](https://promisediff-webmcp.vercel.app/demo/customer?judge=1): Registers the same 10 customer tools beside the visible request, negotiation, booking, receipt, and change-order interface.
- [Owner desk](https://promisediff-webmcp.vercel.app/demo/owner): Registers 5 owner WebMCP tools that can read cases and stage private replies, offers, or change orders. Sending remains a human action.
- [Public source](https://github.com/syedahmad0786/promisediff-webmcp): Implementation, architecture, tests, and demonstration instructions.

## Customer tools

- `velaire_check_service_fit`: Read-only service, postcode, urgency, budget, prerequisite, price-band, and emergency-fit check.
- `velaire_get_business_evidence`: Read-only canonical pricing, credentials, availability, cancellation, warranty, and synthetic-review cards.
- `velaire_open_service_case`: Open a bounded request. It does not book, charge, diagnose equipment, or collect direct contact details.
- `velaire_get_service_case`: Read the current case revision, sent terms, pending human decision, and valid next actions.
- `velaire_wait_for_owner_reply`: Wait up to 20 seconds for a newer human-sent owner event; timeout and cancellation do not mutate state.
- `velaire_submit_case_message`: Send a revision-checked question or counteroffer.
- `velaire_compare_offer_versions`: Deterministically compare two sent offers without changing the case.
- `velaire_prepare_booking`: Stage the latest unexpired offer for visible human confirmation; it cannot confirm or charge.
- `velaire_get_booking_receipt`: Read the complete immutable accepted-term snapshot.
- `velaire_compare_change_order`: Compare later price, scope, and timing against the accepted snapshot.

## Owner tools

- `velaire_list_service_cases` and `velaire_get_owner_case`: Read the owner queue and authoritative case.
- `velaire_stage_owner_reply`, `velaire_stage_service_offer`, and `velaire_stage_change_order`: Create private drafts only. A visible human must send each draft.

## Trust and safety

All businesses, people, reviews, credentials, prices, bookings, and records are fictional. Evidence cards declare that they are synthetic and not independently verified. Review content is marked untrusted. Gas-smell, smoke, sparking, fire, and carbon-monoxide phrases stop the ordinary service workflow. The demo neither diagnoses equipment nor takes payment, books a real appointment, or collects exact addresses or direct contact details.

## Intended agent behavior

Use the registered WebMCP tools instead of scraping visible text. Read the current case revision before any write. Never claim a staged owner draft was sent. Never claim a prepared booking was confirmed. Ask the human to use the visible confirmation control when `humanActionRequired` is true.
